title: Adelaide Gaol

terrainReference.basis: Original mapped frontage grade before the southwest entry approach.

mapIdentity.scope: The identified Adelaide Gaol boundary, mapped historic perimeter controls, central radial yard walls, 13 building plans and the exact two octagonal footprints. The 2022 state LiDAR building occupancy independently locates the south-facing roof edge.

note: The City of Adelaide heritage record supplies the 18-foot exterior wall, 10-foot interior walls, octagonal towers and two-storey T-shaped 1879 addition. Surviving site relief is from the original Terrarium field.
